learning_outcomes.text: Can understand how to set up factory for different products
Can build all necessary systems for a complete facility starting from product design and market research
Learns how to use factory resources optimally.

syllabus_topics: INTRODUCTION: Factory design, its operating environment, stages in factory design, definition of selection problem in factories, selection examples.
PROCESS SELECTION: Explanationcomparison of manufacturing processes, PRIMA matrix, process selection flow charts, importance of cost in process select.
PROCESS SELECTION: Explanationcomparison of manufacturing processes, PRIMA matrix, process selection flow charts, importance of cost in process select.
MACHINERY SELECTION: Selection of machineries using multi-criteria selection models. Models of various machineries.
MACHINERY SELECTION: Selection of machineries using multi-criteria selection models. Models of various machineries.
MATERIAL HANDLING: Goals of material handling. The 20 principles of material handling. The material handling problem-solving procedure.
MATERIAL HANDLING SYSTEM SELECTION: AS/RS systems, Conveyors, Automated Guided Vehicle Systems, Trucks, Cranes.
FORMATION OF PLANT LAYOUT: Layout types such as Function layout, Line layout, Project layout, Cellular Layout. Advantages and disadvantages of each layout.
INITIAL LAYOUT FORMATION AND ITS IMPROVEMENT IN FUNCTIONAL LAYOUT: From-To chart, Activity relationships diagram, Dimensionless block diagram.
FLEXIBLE MANUFACTURING SYSTEMS (FMS) AND CELLULAR LAYOUTS: Components of FMS: Machining centers, robots, material handling equipments.
OTHER CRITICAL ISSUES IN PLANT DESIGN: Selection of cutting tools, jigsfixtures, calculation of number of machines factory capacity, technology level.

FINANCIAL FEASIBILITY ANALYSIS: Determination of all actual expensesrevenues during the operation of the factory. Understanding all related concepts.
